name: [Negative] App Crashes, Freezes and Glitches
description: Users are experiencing frequent crashes, freezes, and glitches within the app, rendering it unusable. Common symptoms include slow performance, failed logins, and data fetching errors.

name: [Negative] App Crash and Failure to Function
description: Users are experiencing frequent app crashes and the inability to open or use the app, leading to frustration and dissatisfaction.

name: [Negative] Critical App Functionality and Stability Issues
description: Users reported widespread failure of the app to initiate, login, load pages, place orders, and update data, causing frustration and loss of trust in the platform.
